metadata.description: Claude plugins from the Bench Log experiments (@benchlog.ai). Each one keeps your data on your own private page.

plugins.name: wardrobe-tracker
plugins.description: Exp. 001 · A wardrobe Claude remembers: pieces, outfits, color pairings, event plans and shopping gaps.

plugins.name: larder
plugins.description: Exp. 002 · Your pantry, balanced meal plans and the grocery list on one page you and Claude both edit.

plugins.name: footprints
plugins.description: Exp. 003 · A travel map of where you've been, a postcard bucket list and trip plans with tickets and packing.

plugins.name: gourmet-trails
plugins.description: Exp. 004 · A restaurant log built from your food photos, with a wishlist, recommendations and shareable lists.
